items.title: Unfazed by West Asia crisis, fiscal deficit within range at 18.2% in Q1

This data suggests the government will likely meet its fiscal deficit target.

items.title: PM-KISAN scheme gets 5-year extension and Rs 3.1 lakh crore

The government committed ₹3.15 lakh crore for this significant initiative. This financial support aims to boost agricultural productivity and rural economic growth. The scheme has already disbursed over ₹4.47 lakh crore since its launch.

items.title: A deep dive with Rs 84,084 crore scheme for offshore oil and gas exploration

It aims to boost domestic oil and gas production and reserve accretion.  The government will fund half the cost of deepwater exploratory drilling.  This initiative seeks to de-risk exploration for companies and increase production.
